title: WeakpointSetDef
description:
A weakpoint set definition from JSON type `"weakpoint_set"`.

Defines a set of weakpoints for a monster, specifying locations with modified damage multipliers, armor penetration, critical hit chances, coverage, and special effects.

weakpoints.description: List of weakpoints in this set.

Weakpoint.description: A single weakpoint on a monster.

armor_mult.description: Armor multiplier when hitting this weakpoint (by damage type).

coverage_mult.description: Coverage multiplier (e.g. {"point": 0.75} for smaller hit area).

crit_mult.description: Critical hit multiplier when hitting this weakpoint.

damage_mult.description: Damage multiplier when hitting this weakpoint (by damage type).

difficulty.description: Difficulty to hit this weakpoint (melee and/or ranged).

effects.description: Effects applied when this weakpoint is hit.

is_head.description: Whether this weakpoint is on the head.

name.description: Display name of the weakpoint (e.g. "a leg", "the head", "the eye").

WeakpointEffect.description: An effect triggered when a weakpoint is hit.

damage_required.description: Damage required to trigger this effect as [min, max].

duration.description: Duration of the effect in turns (can be [min, max] or single value).

instant_death_chance.description: Whether this effect causes instant death.

intensity.description: Intensity (can be a single value or [min, max]).

message.description: Message displayed when the effect triggers.
